fleet.source: EIA-860M monthly generator inventory (Operating and Retired sheets)
fleet.filter: Plant State = TX, Balancing Authority = ERCO, Technology = Batteries; nameplate MW
fleet.note: Fleet MW is rebuilt from each unit's start and retirement month in the latest inventory, so it can differ slightly from what past monthly editions reported.

queue.source: ERCOT Generator Interconnection Status report, GIS_Report_September2026 (published 2026-10-01), large-generator sheet, technology BA
queue.note: Projects under 10 MW (small-generator sheet) are not included. A project in the queue may never be built; "IA signed" means an interconnection agreement is signed, not that construction has started.

weather.source: Open-Meteo historical weather API (ERA5 reanalysis), daily 2 m temperature at the hub city, degrees F, US/Central days
weather.note: Reanalysis at a grid cell near the city, not a weather-station reading, and not the weather at a specific node.

fuel.source: ERCOT Fuel Mix Report (IntGenbyFuel annual workbooks): settled 15-minute generation by fuel
fuel.definition: Solar (or wind) generation divided by total generation in the same hour, summed over every day of the month; storage charging excluded. Hours are Central time.
